Trace, implement and test: leetcode5 longest palindromic substring back tracking

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<iostream>
#include<vector>
#include<string>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
    int maxLen = 0;
    int start = 0;

public:
    string longestPalindrome(string s) {
        if (s.empty() || s.size() == 1) return s;        
        for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++)
        {
            backTrack(s, i, i);      /* 回溯back tracking开始, 寻找长度为奇数的串  */
            backTrack(s, i, i + 1);  /* 回溯开始, 寻找长度为偶数的串 */
        }
        return s.substr(start, maxLen);
    }

    void backTrack(string s, int left, int right) {
        while(left >= 0 && right < s.length() && s[left] == s[right]) {
            if(right - left + 1 > maxLen) {  /* 发现新的更长的回文串时, 更新全局变量startPos和maxLen */
                start = left;
                maxLen = right - left + 1;
            }
            left--;
            right++;
        }
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string s = "babad";
    auto res = sol.longestPalindrome(s);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
